recording.note: Programme rule 1. The file-specific permission quotes unrestricted editing, sharing, film use and sale of films containing the music; its request not to sell recordings directly is expressly a courtesy, not a non-commercial licence. Musopen attribution is retained. Permission ticket 2008012110017088 is recorded on Commons but its private contents were not inspected. The historic Musopen homepage is not a recording-specific upstream item; no session details are inferred from it.
